items.title: BroadWorks XXE 未授权读文件
items.title_zh: BroadWorks XXE 未授权读文件
items.summary_zh: 未授权远程攻击者可利用OCI XML解析器读取系统敏感配置文件
items.affected: cisco broadworks_application_delivery_platform <ri.2026.07; cisco broadworks_application_server <2026.0
items.repro_note: 向OCI XML解析端点提交外部实体载荷读取文件
items.impact_scope: 统一通信平台，常暴露企业网络
items.description: A vulnerability in the Open Client Interface (OCI) XML Parser of Cisco BroadWorks could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to view sensitive files from the filesystem with the privileges of the Cisco BroadWorks user.

items.title: Barracuda ESG 认证绕过改配置
items.title_zh: Barracuda ESG 认证绕过改配置
items.summary_zh: 未授权远程攻击者可调用配置导入恢复恶意备份，篡改设备全局配置
items.repro_note: 未授权访问配置导入接口，提交构造备份包恢复
items.impact_scope: 邮件安全网关，常暴露公网
items.description: An authentication bypass in Barracuda Email Security Gateway versions earlier than 9.4.0.030 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration.

items.title: Barracuda时区命令注入提权
items.summary_zh: 已认证管理员可在时区配置注入命令，以root权限执行OS命令
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本；限制管理员权限
items.repro_note: 管理员登录后篡改时区字段注入OS命令
items.impact_scope: 安全设备管理面，需高权限登录
items.description: Improper neutralization of shell metacharacters in the timezone configuration field in certain Barracuda appliance products using common Barracuda code allows an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed.

items.title: Webtop转码器 文件类型限制绕过
items.title_zh: Webtop转码器 文件类型限制绕过
items.summary_zh: 认证用户可绕过Webmail限制，使转码器处理非预期文件类型
items.affected: openwave webtop_media_transcoder <1.1.22.0
items.repro_note: 认证用户绕过Webmail直接调用转码接口上传非允许类型
items.description: Openwave Webtop Media Transcoder does not enforce administrator-defined file type restrictions to restrict the file-types to be converted. This may allow an authenticated user to process and convert unintended document types if bypassing the Webmail experience.

items.title: Chrome XML UAF 沙箱内RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者通过恶意HTML触发UAF，在Chrome沙箱内执行代码
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)

items.repro_note: 构造恶意HTML触发XML释放后重用，需用户访问
items.impact_scope: 终端浏览器，用户访问即可能触发
items.description: Use after free in XML in Google Chrome prior to 157.0.8103.50 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

items.title: Outlook UI未警示导致欺骗

items.title: Arista EOS BGP栈溢出可RCE
items.summary_zh: 网络攻击者向启用BGP的设备发送特制报文，可致BGP进程崩溃，或进一步执行代码。
items.action_zh: 升级EOS修复版本；限制BGP对等体并配置ACL
items.repro_note: 需EOS启用BGP且可达，向BGP会话发送特制报文触发栈溢出
items.impact_scope: 路由器/交换机，网络边界与核心
items.description: On affected platforms running Arista EOS with BGP configured, a specially crafted packet can cause the BGP agent to crash. Due to the nature of the vulnerability, it may also be possible for a sophisticated attacker to achieve arbitrary code execution, which could compromise the confidentiality and integrity of the affected system.

items.title: Rails 未授权 初始化不安全(默认凭据)
cwe_labels: 初始化不安全(默认凭据)
items.description: Prior to 8.1.4.1 and 8.0.5.2, a Rails application that processes attachments with ImageMagick may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the server and, when attachments are stored with the Disk service, to read arbitrary files readable by the application process. Those files typically include secret_key_base and credentials for external systems, which may in turn allow escalation to remote code execution or lateral movement to those systems.
